title: Viakifishi (Theme 1: Usafi wa mazingira)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child uses the koloni before a list or an explanation and the semi koloni between two complete sentences that belong together.

floor.question: Andika vizuri: mkate maziwa na chai

steps: Is a list or explanation coming? Koloni.
Two complete linked sentences? Semi koloni.
contexts: environmental cleanliness: vifaa vinavyohitajika: fagio, glavu na mifuko

board.do: Tulihitaji vifaa vitatu ___ fagio, glavu na mifuko.

board.say: Alama ipi inafaa kabla ya orodha?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child adds the koloni and writes one sentence with a semi koloni.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni alama ipi huleta orodha?" Kwa nini "semi koloni" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Ni alama ipi hutenganisha sentensi mbili zinazohusiana?" Kwa nini "koloni" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Ni sentensi ipi imetumia koloni sawa?" Kwa nini "Nilinunua: mkate maziwa sukari." si jibu sahihi?

listen_for: Tulifika mapema, walimu walikuwa bado hawajafika.
misconceptions.ask: Kila upande unaweza kusimama kama sentensi kamili?
misconceptions.repair: Semi koloni huunganisha sentensi mbili kamili zinazohusiana.

checks.question: Alama ipi huunganisha sentensi kamili mbili zinazohusiana?
Andika vizuri: Mahitaji ni haya maji chakula na makazi.
checks.answer: Mahitaji ni haya: maji, chakula na makazi.
